title: Make Diagonal Resizing less pixel-perfect by copying windows easier implementation
line: Widget popups like Kickoff and the System Tray can now be resized diagonally by grabbing anywhere near a corner, like windows.
explanation: WindowResizeHandler tested each popup edge only within its own frame margin (about 4-5 px with Breeze), so a diagonal resize only happened where two margins overlap. Because the outermost pixel ring is outside the input mask, the usable corner was about 3x4 px. Now a press on an edge within twice the font's 'M' height of a corner (the same corner size window decorations use) also counts as the neighbouring edge, so corners are about 28 px long; edges that cannot resize (next to a panel) stay excluded.

commits.message:
WindowResizeHandler: Make popup corners easier to grab for resizing

Each edge of a popup was only hit-tested within its own margin, so a
diagonal resize needed a press in a corner of a few pixels. Like window
decorations, a press on an edge near a corner now resizes both ways.

BUG: 527999

media.caption: Master: five presses near Kickoff's top-right corner, each dragged up-right. Presses on the edge 9 px from the corner resize only one way; only a 3x4 px spot resizes diagonally.
Fix: the same five presses. The presses on the edge 9 px from the corner now resize diagonally.
Master: press 2 px in from the right edge, 9 px below the corner, dragged up-right: the popup only gets wider.
Fix: the same press and drag: the popup gets wider and taller.

review.text: Fixes the real cause in WindowResizeHandler::hitTest: each edge was only hit-tested in its own margin, so diagonal resize needed a tiny overlap. Extending an edge press near a corner to the neighbouring edge mirrors how decorations size corners, and the result is still masked by activeEdges, so edges next to a panel stay excluded. Small, self-contained, and the before/after presses at exact offsets show the change.
